name: SherLostHolmes
tagline: A detective-themed lost-and-found with blind lineups, an AI interrogator and a decoy to catch false claims.

awards: SAP - Sponsor Challenge // SAP - Défi commandité

problem: Lost-and-found systems are slow and easy to game with false claims.
solution: Semantic matching of descriptions, anonymised blurred lineups, an AI persona that asks ownership questions, a hidden decoy that flags fraud, plus lockers and a slot machine for unclaimed items.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe a bottle, pick from the lineup and pass the interrogation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “SAP - Sponsor Challenge // SAP - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
The decoy item turns fraud detection into a game mechanic.

lessons: A theme can carry a security idea when every mechanic serves it.
